about: Trigger eval for the who-to-contact skill: does the agent load the skill for these requests? Method: agentskills.io 'Optimizing skill descriptions' (about 20 queries, 3 runs each, a fixed train and validation split). Run with the Context.dev server disconnected, so a run that loads the skill stops at setup and spends no credits.

queries.query: who should I pitch at linear.app? we sell a feature flag tool
need the VP Sales and head of SDRs at gong.io, linkedin links pls
My manager wants finance leaders at our top 40 accounts, domains are in q1_targets.csv
find decision makers @ ramp.com
I'm cold emailing Notion about our HR software. Who would I even address it to?
Who owns SOC 2 at drata.com? Building an outbound list for our compliance tool.
who should I contact at stripe.com? marketing leaders
who runs engineering at vercel.com
get me the email of the head of marketing at figma.com

what's the phone number of the CFO at brex.com?
mcp login context keeps failing with a 401 in Codex, how do I re-auth the Context.dev server?
queries.acceptable_if_loaded: Loading is fine when the skill answers from references/setup.md and runs no search (SKILL.md scope rule).

queries.based_on: Anthropic account-tiering trigger "which accounts should I focus on" plus Lusha "what should I work on this week". https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/HEAD/sales/skills/account-tiering/SKILL.md

notes: Queries 9 and 21 ask for an email or a phone number. The skill should load and say it fetches neither, so the agent does not reach for people-enrich (a paid lookup) on its own.
Query 16 is the request that made Codex load the skill on 18 Nov 2026 (measurements F64).
Query 13 made Codex claim to apply this skill and print 50 companies from memory (18 Nov). The scope rule and the description boundary now stop that.
Rows 22-40 (20 Nov 2026) come from vendor example prompts and published skills (research report 'Contact finding prompts users type'). based_on gives each source.
